d: Our client is a leading global asset management firm with a strong international presence and an expanding institutional business across the Middle East.

The firm offers a comprehensive range of investment solutions spanning fixed income, equities, private markets, real estate, and alternative investments, serving institutional and professional investors globally.

As part of its continued growth in Saudi Arabia, our client is seeking a highly experienced Senior Relationship Manager at Director or Executive Director level to develop institutional relationships, expand distribution capabilities, and support the firm's long-term strategic growth in the Kingdom.
The successful candidate will be responsible for managing and expanding relationships with institutional investors across Saudi Arabia, with a primary focus on Riyadh.
The position requires an established network of institutional clients, strong investment product knowledge, and significant experience in institutional capital raising and investment distribution.
The successful individual will play a key role in strengthening the firm's institutional presence in Saudi Arabia while working closely with regional leadership and global investment teams.
